title: Loops
goal: for, while, do-while, nested loops, break/continue aur dry run se iteration master karna.
definition: Loop ek block ko condition ke true rahne tak repeat karta hai. C me for (count-controlled), while (condition-controlled) aur do-while (at least once) loops hain.
explain: for (init; condition; update) tab best hai jab iterations ki count pata ho. while tab jab condition pehle se pata ho. do-while body pehle chalata hai, phir condition check karta hai.
break loop se turant bahar nikalta hai; continue current iteration ka baaki body skip karke next iteration par jaata hai.
Nested loops me inner loop har outer iteration ke liye poora chalta hai — O(n*m). Pattern printing isi ka classic use hai.
Infinite loop se bacho: condition kabhi false na ho, ya update bhool jao. Dry run table banao: iteration, variables, output.
analogy: Loop ek conveyor belt hai: har round par ek item process hota hai, aur stop button (condition) belt rokta hai. break emergency stop hai, continue current item skip karke belt chalte rehna.
why: Har algorithm me repetition hai — sums, searches, patterns, matrices. Loop ki off-by-one galti aur infinite loop sabse common bugs hain; dry run unhe pakadta hai.

syntax.note: for/while zero times chal sakte hain; do-while kam se kam ek baar.
Inner loop har outer i ke liye poora chalta hai.

topics.title: for loop
topics.body: init ek baar, condition har iteration se pehle, update har iteration ke baad. C99 se loop variable declaration for ke andar allowed hai. i <= n vs i < n — boundary dhyan se.

topics.title: while aur do-while
topics.body: while pehle test karta hai; do-while body ke baad test karta hai, isliye menu/input retry ke liye sahi hai. do-while ke condition ke baad semicolon zaroori.

topics.title: break, continue, nested
topics.body: break nearest loop se exit; continue next iteration. Nested loops me labelled break nahi hota (goto ya flag use karo). Loop ke andar loop variable modify mat karo.

topics.title: Classic number algorithms
topics.body: Sum of digits (n%10, n/10), reverse, palindrome, factorial, prime check (sqrt tak), Fibonacci, Armstrong, GCD. In sab me loop + arithmetic ka core pattern repeat hota hai.

examples.title: Sum, factorial, table
lines: Ek loop me sum aur factorial dono accumulate hote hain.
fact long me hai kyunki 13! int se bada ho jaata hai.
Doosra loop multiplication table print karta hai.

examples.title: Prime, reverse aur digit sum
lines: Har digit n%10 se nikalta hai, n/10 se hat jaata hai.
Palindrome check reversed number se compare karta hai.
Prime check sirf sqrt(p) tak chalta hai — O(sqrt n).

mistakes.why: Update galat direction me jaata hai — infinite loop.
Off-by-one null terminator ko bhi process karta hai; strlen har iteration call karna O(n^2) hai.

mistakes.wrong: while (n > 0) { ... }  // n kabhi change nahi hota
mistakes.right: loop ke andar n-- ya progress
mistakes.why: Condition hamesha true rahegi — infinite loop.

debug.brief: Factorial 5 ka 0 aa raha hai. Fix karo.
hints: Multiplication ka identity element kya hai?

best: Loop variable ka scope chhota rakho (for me declare)
strlen/sizeof ko loop me har baar calculate mat karo
Infinite loop se bachne ke liye progress guarantee karo

mcqs.q: do-while kam se kam kitni baar chalta hai?
mcqs.explain: Body pehle chalti hai, phir condition check hoti hai.
Current iteration ki baaki body skip, next iteration.

mcqs.q: for (int i=0;i<3;i++) for(int j=0;j<3;j++) — kitni baar body?

interview.q: for aur while me kab kya?
interview.a: Jab iterations ki count pata ho to for; jab condition data-driven ho (EOF tak, sentinel tak) to while. Dono equivalent hain — readability decide karti hai.
interview.followUp: do-while ka best use? — menu jise kam se kam ek baar dikhana hai.

interview.q: Loop me array ka size har baar calculate karna kyun bura hai?
interview.a: strlen O(n) hai; loop condition me call karne se total O(n^2). Ek baar len nikal lo. Compiler kuch cases optimize karta hai par bharosa mat karo.
interview.followUp: size_t loop ke saath warning? — signed/unsigned comparison warning; size_t use karo.

interview.q: Infinite loop ko intentionally kaise likhte hain?
interview.a: for (;;) ya while (1) with a break. Embedded/event loops aise likhe jaate hain; exit condition clear honi chahiye.
interview.followUp: Compiler warning? — -Wunreachable-code se baad ka code pakda ja sakta hai.
